ORDINANCE VIII OF 1977
BALUCHISTAN CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
An Ordinance to amend the
Baluchistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act No. IX of 1974)
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 3rd November 1977]
No. Leegis. l-12/73 Law.-The following
Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 3rd November 1977, is
hereby published for general information : -
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Baluchistan Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on twenty second day of February
1977.

Amendment to clause (iii) of section 13 of the Baluchistan Act. No. IX of 1974

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1977
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1977
BALUCHISTAN CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
An Ordinance to amend the
Baluchistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act No. IX of 1974)
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 3rd November 1977]
No. Leegis. l-12/73 Law.-The following
Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 3rd November 1977, is
hereby published for general information : -
2. Amendment to clause (iii) of section 13 of the Baluchistan Act. No.
IX of 1974.--In clause (iii) of section 13 of the Baluchistan Civil
Servants Act, 1974, the word "sixtieth" shall be substituted for the
word "fifty-eight."
